intended_input_set: All registered final frozen shared-test positions, reuse their accepted original videos; no new generation.
temporal_flickering_scope: Only preregistered static-eligible inputs as quality; other videos descriptive or not applicable, never a universal higher-is-better quality claim.
required_prompt_binding: Explicit source inference prompt for each case/video, no method names or filename-derived text.
required_identity: Original file SHA, decode geometry/FPS/all93-frame audit, then evaluator actual per-dimension frame selection recorded separately.
aggregation: Video scalar then registered two-seed prompt mean then prompt-equal means; preserve all rejected/failed/missing metric positions; no zero imputation.
scorer_setup: Freeze one actual source implementation, resource paths/SHA, no implicit downloads, isolated dependencies, actual CPU and cost validation before GPU scoring.
